summary: Narrow residential road with houses 10-14 m away and no kerbside room.

best_section.where: east kerb north of the mid-block tree, by the park edge

drivers.seclusion: Detached dwellings 11-13 m from the kerb along the east side; houses on the west too.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane with tree-lined edges and no visible shoulder or pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Through road linking suburbs; moderate traffic.
drivers.convention: No Stopping Any Time signs at the start; few cars parked beyond the first 30 m.

sun_shade: Heavy tree shade from both sides along the middle; open to morning sun at the north end.
